messages:
Margo (CS): quick flag — onboarding call with Velosphere this morning. they love the latency but 3 asks surfaced that could impact renewal if not addressed. copying notes below.
Victor (CSM): short summary: they started pilot at 40k tokens/day, saw costs spike when multiple routes hit. CFO is asking for per-campaign cost splits and an SLA on webhook delivery/retries. risk = medium-high.
Margo (CS): customer verbatim ask:
```
- per-route webhook retries (exponential backoff + dead-letter)
- ability to tag requests for per-campaign cost attribution
- clearer per-route latency percentile metrics (p50/p95 by route)
```
Margo (CS): they also mentioned one integration failure last week — webhook 502s retried by their infra and caused duplicated downstream actions. they want Redwood to offer server-side retry with idempotency tokens. :grimacing:
Neil (PM): thanks — important signals. can you add usage examples or logs? also curious how many routes they run (few vs many). putting this on intake board. @Margo can you drop the logs/link? :eyes:
Margo (CS): attaching a short sample from their engineering lead in thread (they pasted a curl + header snippet):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/ingest -H "X-Idempotency: 12345" -d '{"route":"lead-scoring","payload":{...}}'
```
Margo (CS): they said ~6 routes: scoring, enrichment, summarization, embeddings, rerank, billing-annotate. main pain is the scoring route where retries caused duplicates.
Ashley (Eng): feasibility notes — server-side retry with idempotency is possible but we need request-id propagation and a DLQ. per-route retry config would require changes to routing layer and metrics tagging. rough effort 2-3 sprints for a minimal impl.
Victor (CSM): thanks Ashley. for prioritization, customer is sensitive to cost visibility first (CFO), then retries (ops risk). if we can deliver a tagging MVP for cost logs, that might buy time.
Neil (PM): proposal: split into 3 workstreams — (1) cost-tagging MVP (logging + exports) (2) metrics per-route (observability) (3) server-side retry + idempotency (infra). ask: which is lowest-effort quick win?
Ashley (Eng): lowest effort = cost-tagging via metadata header passthrough and export mapping. we can add `x-rw-campaign` header and include in usage CSV. ~1 sprint plus telemetry changes.
Neil (PM): ok add cost-tagging MVP to next sprint. can someone create a feature ticket with acceptance criteria and sample payloads?
Margo (CS): I'm on it — will create a ticket and add customer logs + prioritization (CFO wants export by EOW).
triage-bot: created ticket RW-6221: "Cost tagging MVP for per-campaign attribution" assigned to Product; link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-6221 :white_check_mark:
Emma (Support): added a support thread linking the duplicate request refs: https://support.redwood.com/t/9876 — includes the integration failure trace.
Neil (PM): thanks team. Ashley — can you provide a short technical note on constraints (idempotency token format, DLQ retention) by Thu? that'll help scope retries work.
Ashley (Eng): yep, putting a short doc in the ticket by Thu.
Victor (CSM): I'll follow up with customer and push timeline expectations. will mention cost-export MVP first. :thumbsup:
Margo (CS): closing loop here — I'll post updates in this thread after the ticket is fleshed out and after next sprint planning. thanks all.
